text: Coaches — how are you actually getting clients from Instagram? Feels like I'm posting into the void. Reels, stories, DMs... what's actually working for you right now?
comment_source_reason: A question only people already running a coaching/creator/small-business Instagram can answer — respondents describing their own IG strategy are the app's exact buyer type (professionals/creators/small-business owners who market themselves and need video to post consistently), and video editors/tools pitching in the replies are direct competitors.
